description: This PHP class 'AgeGroup' extends 'FilterField' and provides functionality to add age-related filtering conditions to a database query within a human resource management system. It defines methods to generate query expressions based on age operators and age values, utilizing date difference calculations.

classes.name: AgeGroup
classes.description: A class that implements age-based filtering logic for database queries, allowing filtering employees by age ranges using operators like less than, greater than, or between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds age-based filtering conditions to a query builder depending on the specified operator and age values.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases involved in filtering, here it is ['employee'].
